answer.explanation: Subscription, a domain class, imports SystemClock from the outbound adapters layer (line 1) and instantiates it directly (line 4) to read the current time in isActive. FF-S04 flags this because core code should not depend on adapters or I/O; a Clock port would normally invert that dependency. ADR-0002 is Accepted and explicitly permits the domain core to import SystemClock from src/adapters/outbound/system-clock.ts directly and defers a Clock port, so the finding is consistent with the declared intent and this exact case is granted on purpose.

citation.quote: The domain core is permitted to import SystemClock from src/adapters/outbound/system-clock.ts directly.

exceptionClaim.scope: Domain core importing SystemClock directly from src/adapters/outbound/system-clock.ts, with no Clock port for now.
